channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Minnesota Yacht Club’s 2026 festival lineup coming Tuesday
item.description: Organizers asked fans to guess who might be playing the three-day music fest set for July 17-19 on St. Paul’s Harriet Island.

item.title: Takeaways: Wild end road trip with 4-1 victory at Seattle
item.description: Mats Zuccarello departed because of a first-period injury, but Marcus Johansson scored a go-ahead goal in the third period and Filip Gustavsson made 23 saves.

item.title: Cause under investigation of fire that severely damaged mosque and school in Prior Lake
item.description: Part of the roof collapsed, but no one was hurt in the blaze at the Masjid Hamza mosque and Baitul Hikmah Academy.

item.title: Takeaways: Timberwolves stumble against Suns as five-game winning streak ends
item.description: Anthony Edwards’ 40 points couldn’t save his otherwise cold-shooting team, which had to go without Rudy Gobert after he was ejected in the third quarter.

item.title: Love, lies and the law intersect at Twin Cities trial over STD transmission, defamation
item.description: A romantic relationship that started on Tinder led to a civil jury trial in Hennepin County District Court that ended with monetary damages being awarded for inflicting emotional distress.

item.title: Former UnitedHealth CEO McGuire to join health care talks between Fairview, U of M
item.description: Minnesota Attorney General Keith Ellison is tapping a retired judge and Dr. William McGuire for negotiations between the U, its doctors and Fairview Health Services.

item.title: Souhan: Yes, I am comparing Vikings QB J.J. McCarthy to Hall of Famer Troy Aikman
item.description: Aikman was knocked around in his winless rookie season in Dallas but eventually emerged as a great leader. Is McCarthy on the same path?

item.title: Minneapolis council considers $46K raise for Frey, may hike their own pay in two years
item.description: The proposal comes two years after a salary survey found the mayor’s salary lags behind other mayors, including St. Paul’s.

item.title: Augsburg president decries ICE detention of a student on private campus
item.description: University officials say agents refused to provide a judicial warrant before taking the student from a private parking lot on campus.

item.title: Trump looms large over Minnesota’s GOP race for governor
item.description: The president’s sway among the Republicans who are seeking Minnesota’s highest office was fully apparent during a gubernatorial candidate forum in southwestern Minnesota.
